from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

# --- CID suite ---
# a) NCID then retire threshold drops seq0 from active; seq0 packet -> DROP_CID later
ncid = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(1) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*16  # seq1, rpt1 -> active {1}
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, ncid, width=1), auth=[0]),
           datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1), auth=[0])])  # dcid aa = seq 0 -> retired
check("ncid-retire-threshold", tr, {'packets.1.status':'DROP_CID', 'retire_prior_to':1,
                                    'peer_cids.0.sequence':1})

# b) retire destination seq -> PROTOCOL_VIOLATION
retire = bytes([0x19]) + W.v(0)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, retire, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("retire-dest", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', 'closed.code':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION', 'retired_local':[]})

# c) retire seq1 (not dest), then packet to bb (seq1) -> DROP_CID ; rollback on later error
retire1 = bytes([0x19]) + W.v(1)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']),
           datagram(envelope('A', 0, retire1, width=1), auth=[0]),
           datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1, cid=b'\xbb'), auth=[0])])
check("retire-then-drop", tr, {'packets.1.status':'DROP_CID', 'retired_local':[[1,2]]})

# d) retire then error in same packet -> rollback retirement
bad = bytes([0x19]) + W.v(1) + b'\x99'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, bad, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("retire-rollback", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'retired_local':[]})

# e) NCID capacity: limits.cids=2, add seq 1 and 2 -> ok (active {0,1,2}?) no: 3 active > 2 -> error
n1 = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*16
n2 = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(2) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xee' + b'\x22'*16
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, n1+n2, width=1), auth=[0])], cids=2)
check("ncid-capacity", tr, {'packets.0.status':'CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR',
                            'closed.offset': len(n1), 'peer_cids': [{'sequence':0,'id':'cc','token':'00'*16}]})

# f) NCID duplicate seq with different token -> PV
bad2 = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(0) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xcc' + b'\x11'*16
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, bad2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ncid-dup-seq", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})

# g) CID bytes in two sequences -> PV
n1 = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(1) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x11'*16
n2 = bytes([0x18]) + W.v(2) + W.v(0) + bytes([1]) + b'\xdd' + b'\x22'*16
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, n1+n2, width=1), auth=[0])])
check("ncid-cid-two-seqs", tr, {'packets.0.status':'PROTOCOL_VIOLATION'})
